about.title: A developer who sees the product through — not just the code
paragraphs: I'm Áron, a web developer. I build systems that run in production and serve real businesses every day — not just demos.

My focus sits at the intersection of three areas: custom web applications, AI integration, and full SaaS products. I like projects that start from a real user need and land in a stable, maintainable system.
I enjoy working with SMBs and growing companies where technology genuinely matters to the business — not decoration, a tool.
highlights: AI-powered automation for real business processes
Projects seen through: from planning to support

items.title: L-NYUGTA

items.title: AI customer support assistant
items.summary: A concept for an AI chatbot embedded in a webshop: order-status lookups, FAQ answers, and handoff to a human agent when needed.

items.title: Order & inventory management SaaS concept
items.summary: A design for an order-management and inventory-tracking system for small businesses, with a real-time dashboard and reporting.
